mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP (PDF/Word), parse its text, and convert it into a structured tabular format (e.g., JSON or CSV) that captures sections, subsections, and key clauses. Preserve formatting metadata to aid later extraction.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A structured dataset representing the RFP content with identifiable sections and clause identifiers.

units.description: From the structured RFP dataset, identify all mandatory technical compliance requirements (e.g., security controls, performance SLAs, data residency rules). Output a list of criteria with unique identifiers and concise descriptions.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A table of mandatory technical compliance criteria, each tagged with an RFP clause reference.

units.description: Create a labor pricing model that maps each required technical competency (e.g., cloud architect, security engineer, project manager) to tiered hourly rates and estimated effort hours per RFP requirement. Include assumptions for skill level distribution and contingency buffers.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A structured pricing table with tiers, rates, effort estimates, and total cost projections.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that: (1) summarizes the solution approach, (2) presents the multi‑tier labor pricing model, (3) includes a compliance traceability matrix linking each RFP requirement to the proposed solution element and cost line item, and (4) provides an executive summary of benefits and risk mitigation. Output should be in a professional report format (e.g., Markdown or Word).
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2, t3]
units.output_contract: A complete executive proposal document with embedded compliance traceability matrix.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal that satisfies all mandatory technical compliance criteria from the uploaded government cloud migration RFP, including a detailed multi‑tier labor pricing model and a traceability matrix linking each requirement to the proposed solution.
dag.reasoning: The user requests a multi‑step process: ingest the RFP document, extract compliance requirements, build a labor cost model, and produce a proposal with traceability.
